Messages.Author: dfvtes
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

I've read a few conflicting posts and can't find anything definitive.

Can action modifiers / reactions be played when Veles' Hunt is called ?

I was under the impression that, being labelled as a Bloodhunt Referendum, that no action modifiers or reactions can be played.

However it was pointed out to me that Bloodhunt Referendums dont inherently stop reactions or modifiers, it's just that they are (usually) called after diablerie and arent actions themselves so cant be reacted to or modified. As Veles' Hunt is a political action then it can be modified and reacted to.

Name: Veles' Hunt
[KoT:R]
Cardtype: Political Action
Clan: Gangrel
Cost: 3 pool
Blood hunt referendum.
Choose an ally or younger non-titled vampire controlled by your prey. Successful referendum means that minion is burned. If this referendum fails or is canceled, no more Veles' Hunts can be played this game.
Artist: Ken Meyer, Jr.

Edit: spellings and card text

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> dfvtes wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I've read a few conflicting posts and can't find anything definitive.
>
> Can action modifiers / reactions be played when Veles' Hunt is called ?
>
Yes.

> dfvtes wrote:
> I was under the impression that, being labelled as a Bloddhunt Referendum, that no action modifiers or reactions.
>
No. This rule applies only during the blood hunt referendum of a diablerie.

> dfvtes wrote:
> However it was pointed out to me that Bloodhunt Referendums dont inherently stop reactions or modifiers, it's just that they are (usually) called after diablerie and arent actions themselves so cant be reacted to or modified.
>
Correct.

See groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/hlK89M1M9rk/m/k2mbokPTCccJ

>
> > Remember that the reason VC, BO, et al cannot
